title: 第6章 屠夫学徒第7章 不正常的屠宰场
lines: 烈日当空，晒得楚生莫名有些烦躁。
楚生手指抹了抹鼻头，无语道：“柳玉，没想到你这么快就勾搭上叶亮这个废物，以前是我看错你了。”
“现在，我对你不感兴趣，别自作多情。”
叶亮闻言，立马炸了起来，推开紧凑的柔软，质问道：“楚生，老子进入青松武馆，你却只能当一个屠夫，还敢说老子是废物，我看你是找死！”
“就是，楚生，我看你就是嫉妒亮哥，说着违心话吧！”柳玉扭着柳腰，小碎步上前，讥讽道：
“亮哥城北首富，家世显赫，如今又是青松武馆学员，成为武者指日可待，你拿什么和亮哥比？”
“是个正常的女人都会选择亮哥这种优秀的男人，你就彻底死了这条心吧，我不会再多看你一眼！”
柳玉说罢便双眸盯着叶亮，像一个迷妹一般的眼神。
叶亮被柳玉这痴迷的眼神看着，不自觉地挺了挺胸膛，心中不禁有些发虚：“我真的有这么优秀吗？”
“没错，我就是这么优秀，楚生这个穷鬼拿什么和我比？”
“要钱，没我有钱；要颜值，没我有钱；要身高，没我有钱；要战斗力，依旧没我有钱；要女人，也不知道柳玉被他玩过没有，找机会得一探究竟……”
心中胡思乱想着，叶亮看向柳玉的眼神闪过一丝邪光，情不自禁觉得很是畅意。
“早知道叶亮那么优秀，你还和我滚玉米地？”楚生一改表情，尽显戏谑。
“你……”叶亮张开口，却说不出话来，心中却是另外一番想法：“好像更刺激了，征服楚生的女人才爽！”
“畜生，你别胡说，我们明明什么都没发生。”柳玉急得原地蹦跶起来，摇晃着叶亮的胳膊说道，“亮哥，你要信我……”
叶亮看着面前晃动的小胸脯，一阵心猿意马，却是佯装柔情道：“玉儿，我肯定相信你！”
“畜生这个卑贱的穷鬼，想挑拨我们关系，我不会让他得逞的。”
楚生听到叶亮的话，不由得一惊，这家伙什么时候长脑子了？
楚生接着又看到叶亮听到自己话语后，眼神中流露出兴奋的淫光，心底猜测道：“难道这叶亮，还有孟德之好？”
收回心思，楚生对着昔日同窗和旧青梅，摆了摆手，坦然道：“没时间和你们瞎扯，我有事先走了。”
“羞辱我和玉儿就想走，没门！”叶亮一招手，身后的两个健壮小厮就摩拳擦掌地围了上来。
“小子，得罪我家三少爷，你死定了。”两个小厮嘲讽道。
柳玉这时也笑吟吟道：“楚生，你死定了！”
楚生收起笑容，面色瞬间凌厉起来，眼神透露出一股宛如实质一般的杀意，空气刹那间凝固。
“叶亮，看来进入武馆，让你丢失了很多回忆啊……”楚生冷眸死死盯住叶亮，冰冷的话语一字一句蹦出，“既然如此，今天我就帮你回忆回忆！”
不好的回忆在脑海翻滚，叶亮猛然一缩，声音颤抖道：“行…我放过你一马…我们撤！”
两个小厮：“三少爷……”
柳玉跺了跺脚，不服气道：“亮哥，你怎么……”
“我说了，撤！”叶亮尖锐喝道。
大庭广众之下，几人的争吵，早引起了周围人的关注，楚生内心并不想动手，以免引起不必要的麻烦。
楚生放任几人离开，然后才慢悠悠朝着屠宰场的方向走去。
content_en:
The scorching sun was in the sky, making Chu Sheng inexplicably irritable.
Chu Sheng wiped his nose with his finger and said speechlessly: "Liu Yu, I didn't expect you to hook up with Ye Liang, a loser, so quickly. I misjudged you before."
"Now, I'm not interested in you, so don't be pretentious."
When Ye Liang heard this, he immediately exploded, pushed away the compact softness, and asked: "Chu Sheng, I entered the Qingsong Martial Arts School, but you can only be a butcher, and you dare to call me a waste. I think you are seeking death!"
"That's right, Chu Sheng, I think you are just jealous of Brother Liang, and you are saying things that go against your will!" Liu Yu twisted her waist, stepped forward, and said sarcastically:
"Brother Liang is the richest man in the north of the city. He has a distinguished family background. Now he is a student of Qingsong Martial Arts School. He is just around the corner to become a martial artist. How can you compare with Brother Liang?"
"A normal woman would choose an outstanding man like Brother Liang. Just give up on this idea completely. I won't look at you again!"
After Liu Yu said this, she stared at Ye Liang with eyes like a obsessed girl.
Looking at Liu Yu's obsessed eyes, Ye Liang puffed up his chest unconsciously and felt a little guilty in his heart: "Am I really that good?"
"Yes, I am so good. How can a poor guy like Chu Sheng compare with me?"
"If you want money, you don't have as much money as me; if you want good looks, you don't have as much money as me; if you want height, you don't have as much money as me; if you want fighting power, you still don't have as much money as me; if you want a woman, I don't know if Liu Yu has been played by him. I have to find out if I find a chance..."
With random thoughts in his mind, Ye Liang's eyes flashed with an evil light when he looked at Liu Yu, and he couldn't help but feel very comfortable.
"If I had known that Ye Liang was so good, why would you still play in the cornfield with me?" Chu Sheng changed his expression to show his playfulness.
"You..." Ye Liang opened his mouth, but was unable to speak. He had another thought in his heart: "It seems more exciting. Only the woman who conquers Chu Sheng will be happy!"
"Beast, don't talk nonsense. Nothing happened to us." Liu Yu was so anxious that she jumped up and shook Ye Liang's arm and said, "Brother Liang, you have to believe me..."
Ye Liang looked at the small breasts swaying in front of him and felt distraught for a while, but he pretended to be tender and said: "Yu'er, I definitely believe you!"
"This despicable poor beast wants to sow discord between us. I won't let him succeed."
When Chu Sheng heard Ye Liang's words, he couldn't help but be surprised. When did this guy grow a brain?
Chu Sheng then saw Ye Liang's eyes showing excitement after hearing his words, and he guessed in his heart: "Is this Ye Liang as good as Meng Dezhi?"
After withdrawing his thoughts, Chu Sheng waved his hand to his former classmates and old childhood memories, and said calmly: "I don't have time to talk nonsense with you. I have to leave beforehand."
"You want to leave just because you humiliate me and Yu'er, there's no way!" Ye Liang waved, and the two strong boys behind him gathered around him.
"Boy, if you offend my third young master, you will die." The two boys mocked.
Liu Yu also smiled and said: "Chu Sheng, you are dead!"
Chu Sheng put away his smile, his face turned sharp in an instant, his eyes revealed a murderous intent that was as real as real, and the air solidified in an instant.
"Ye Liang, it seems that entering the martial arts gym has made you lose a lot of memories..." Chu Sheng stared at Ye Liang with his cold eyes, and said cold words one by one, "In that case, I will help you recall your memories today!"
Bad memories were rolling in his mind. Ye Liang shrank suddenly and said with a trembling voice: "Okay...I'll let you go...let's retreat!"
Two young men: "Third Young Master..."
Liu Yu stamped her feet and said unconvinced: "Brother Liang, why are you..."
"I said, withdraw!" Ye Liang shouted sharply.
The quarrel between a few people in public had already attracted the attention of the people around him, but Chu Sheng didn't want to do anything to avoid causing unnecessary trouble.
Chu Sheng allowed several people to leave, and then walked slowly towards the direction of the slaughterhouse.
title_en: Chapter 6 The Butcher’s Apprentice Chapter 7 The Abnormal Slaughterhouse
